name: Gemini in Workspace
tagline: Gemini in Workspace embeds Google's AI directly into Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Meet for over 3 billion users. In Gmail it drafts and summarises emails. In Docs it writes, rewrites, and proofreads. In Sheets it generates formulas and analyses data. In Meet it provides real-time AI captions, summaries, and action items. Available as part of Google Workspace Business and Enterprise plans, it represents one of the largest-scale AI deployments in the world, bringing AI assistance to the tools billions of people use for work daily.
